explication: OpenMRS Core is a customizable, patient-based electronic medical record platform. Its main product workflow is managing patient and clinical records through domain services, with a web application as a user-facing deployment. The repository also includes terminology, scheduling, HL7 messaging, and file storage capabilities. The graph reflects the documented product and source-index references; unsampled implementation links are omitted rather than inferred.
